chunks: As-Sayyid ar-Radi (may Allah be pleased with him) says: I say: And a part of this speech has already passed in what preceded from the sermons, except that there is here an addition which necessitated its repetition.

key_terms.السَّيِّدُ الرَّضِيُّ: The title of the compiler of Nahj al-Balagha, Al-Sharif ar-Radi

ai.seo_question: Why did As-Sayyid ar-Radi repeat part of Imam Ali's will in the chapter on his death?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi clarifies that while the core message of Imam Ali’s will was previously presented in the sermons, he reintroduces it here to incorporate specific additions relevant to the context of his final days. This editorial choice highlights the distinct nature of the will as a testamentary document, emphasizing its unique legal and spiritual directives separate from the broader rhetorical themes of the sermons.
